REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-57224  Recommendation to receive and file the Review of FY 2025 Business Plan
  Accomplishments and FY 2026 Look-Ahead.

  A motion was made by Vice President Cordero, seconded by Commissioner
  Maguire, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott, Austin
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  President Scott delivered opening remarks for the Board retreat and outlined the
  purpose of the meeting: to review FY 2025 performance, recognize operational and
  leadership challenges, and align the Board and management on FY 2026 priorities.
  He highlighted key accomplishments from FY 2025 and noted the Board’s
  responsibility for maintaining essential utility and public trust.

  President Scott identified key areas of focus for FY 2026, including the utilities’
  strategic plan, system upgrades, workforce planning, financial planning, and
  preparations for LA28. He noted the importance of the Board working closely with

President Scott introduced General Manager Anatole Falagan to begin the
program.

Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, thanked President Scott
for his comments and recognized the work of Utilities staff. He explained that his
remarks were introductory and that the executive team would present information
on operations and key strategic issues. He concluded his introduction and turned
the presentation over to Tai Tseng, Assistant General Manager, Utilities
Department.

Tai Tseng, Assistant General Manager, Utilities Department, introduced his
business unit and recognized the six division managers. He provided a brief
overview of FY 2025 accomplishments, highlighting responses to water main
breaks, financial and operational improvements, SCADA modernization, and
emergency response.

customer debt management, including strategies for outreach, community
partnerships,and resuming turnoffs while maintaining service.

  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, reviewed FY 2025
  achievements and FY 2026 plans, highlighting key projects, staff development,
  infrastructure upgrades, and LA28 preparation. He thanked staff and emphasized

  Board members expressed appreciation for the presentations, noting that the FY
